_meta.title: Validated pyAether schematic & layout API inventory (MCP-sourced, eval-cross-checked)
_meta.motivation: R177 found SFT hallucinates lib.openSchematic for real API dbCrtSchWire => v8 corpus (25 pairs/11 APIs) too thin to teach correct call patterns. This inventory enumerates real APIs via local pyAether MCP, records EXACT signatures, cross-checks each against the 158-task eval set to classify contamination risk, so the next SFT corpus (v9) can close the gap WITHOUT violating the pollution red line.

safety_legend.SAFE: eval_count==0 => API not in any eval task => may be used freely in training corpus
safety_legend.ISOLATE: eval_count>0 => API in eval tasks => teach ONLY from official doc (MCP get_api_details), never replicate eval-task prompts/signatures/assertions; scan each pair vs eval entry_points

_meta.red_line_compliance: Pollution isolation (S5.1): 158 tasks' prompt+signature+assertion must NOT enter training. SAFE APIs uncontaminated (eval_count==0). ISOLATE APIs taught ONLY from official API reference.

actionable_findings.v8_gap_confirmed: v8 (11 APIs/25 pairs) covers only schematic-create APIs; ZERO coverage of 4 core layout-create APIs (dbCrtRect/dbCrtPolygon/dbCrtInst/dbCrtPath) that eval uses most heavily (48 eval references). Layout scenario (64 tasks) is the largest coverage gap.
actionable_findings.safe_expansion_set: 7 new SAFE APIs (eval=0) for v9 with ZERO contamination risk: dbSchGetPinOrder, aeSchStretch, aeCrtWireLabelsAndPins, emyDesignIsSchematic (+ leGuiCrtWire excluded as low-value). With 6 SAFE APIs already in v8, SAFE schematic pool ~13 APIs.
actionable_findings.isolate_handling: 9 ISOLATE APIs (eval>0) teachable from official doc but each pair must scan vs eval entry_points (R177 method: 155 entry_points scan). dbCrtInst/dbCrtRect/dbCrtNet are highest-value ISOLATE targets (Layout scenario).
actionable_findings.root_cause_of_r177_hallucination: SFT hallucinated lib.openSchematic because v8 pairs show API NAME in doc but do not reinforce exact call pattern pyScript.dbCrtSchWire(cv=..., point=...) enough in varied contexts. v9 fix: more pairs/API + multi-step traces (openCV->create->save), not just doc->single-call.
actionable_findings.next_step: Build v9 corpus: (1) 3-5 pairs per SAFE API using EXACT MCP signatures (~13 APIs => ~50 pairs); (2) ISOLATE APIs from official doc with entry_point scan (target 4 layout-create APIs for Layout-scenario coverage); (3) multi-step traces. Retrain needs GPU6-7 (serve-held per 17:10 order) OR validate via eval when sandbox ACL opens.
